candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet selection and adoption certificate generation so users customize their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users early and adoption drops 39.1%. Allowing users to build emotional attachment first increases account creation motivation.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet Companion
sign_in.body: Sign in now to secure your adopted pet profile and preserve your progress.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after the adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Delays sign-in until after emotional attachment, targeting major funnel dropoffs.

candidates.title: Split-Screen Companion Persona Selector
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout showcasing side-by-side animated pet previews and personality choices.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%) and long completion times (89s median / 1017s mean).

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen into a split layout preserves its core job of choosing a pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns adoption step which has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%).

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility & Permission Verification Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated verification screen after waiting to check desktop rendering and prompt for window permissions before completing setup.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple reports of pets failing to display on desktop or the app stalling right after generation.

new_desktop_test.headline: Test Desktop Companion Visibility
new_desktop_test.body: Make sure desktop display permissions are granted so your pet appears over other windows.

guard.reason: Adding a permission verification screen inside onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support mail, but adding new screens has historically performed poorly.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Onboarding Completion Hub
candidates.change: Redesign the final intro screen into a spotlight stage layout highlighting essential desktop controls.
